lines.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

data.define: Short for "as soon as possible"; used to ask for something quickly.

example.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

misuse.text: Don't write 'ASAP' to your boss rudely.

publish.title: What does "ASAP" mean?
publish.value: ASAP = As soon as possible. Example: "Please send me the notes ASAP." (casual English).
